meta.name: higgsfield-marketplace-cards
meta.description:
Generate marketplace product image cards through Higgsfield: compliant
main image, secondary product images, and A+ style content modules. Use when
the user asks for marketplace listing images, product detail cards,
secondary product images, product infographics, lifestyle listing shots,
A+ style content, marketplace image sets, or sales-ready product visuals.
Backend owns marketplace compliance references and prompt templates; this skill
only routes user intent to the CLI.
NOT for generic brand product photography without marketplace/listing context
(use higgsfield-product-photoshoot), video generation or UGC ads (use
higgsfield-generate), or Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你要做电商平台的产品图时，Claude 会按需求调用 Higgsfield 命令，生成合规主图、副图或 A+ 内容模块，最后只返回带标签的图片链接。
howto.when: 当你说需要电商平台的产品主图、商品详情卡片、副图或 A+ 内容模块等市场图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这款保温杯生成一张电商主图
say.note: 会生成主图并返回链接。

say.text: 给这瓶精华液做详情图，主图加5张副图
我要A+模块，主图加7个内容模块

howto.what_en: Claude converts your request for marketplace product images into a Higgsfield CLI command, producing compliant main images, secondary images, or A+ modules, and returns only labeled image URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for marketplace listing images, product detail cards, secondary product images, or similar listing-related visuals.

say_en.text: Create a marketplace main image for this stainless bottle.
say_en.note: Runs Higgsfield to generate the main image.

say_en.text: Make product images for this serum: main image plus 5 secondary shots.
I need A+ content modules: main image plus 7 modules.
say_en.note: Generates main image and A+ module URLs.
